title: Contact Genstone Construction | Free Consultation
metaDescription: Contact Genstone Construction about an investment property renovation or a free Pre-Offer Rehab Review, or ask about joining our contractor network.
lede: Let us know who you are so we can help you faster. Investors and contractors usually have different questions, so choose the option that fits and the form will route your message to the right team at Genstone Construction. If you'd rather talk it through, call (312) 429-2637 and tell us about the property or your business.

sections.body:
Your renovation starts here. If you have general questions, complete the form below or call (312) 429-2637.

If you're looking at a property you haven't bought yet, ask for a free Pre-Offer Rehab Review. It estimates repair costs, helps refine the after repair value and checks whether the numbers support your offer. If you already own the property, tell us about it and we'll start on a detailed scope and estimate.

It helps to include the property address, your strategy (flip, rental, BRRRR, small multifamily or other), your target timeline, and any photos or inspection reports you have.

If you have general questions, complete the form below. If you're interested in joining our network of contractors, visit the Pre-Application Checklist page for details on the five required documents, then complete the Contractor Application. Current partners with a question about an active project should contact their Genstone project manager directly.
